northStarGoal: Maximize organic click-through rate to the DisclosurePro AI app (play_store_click, blog_cta_click, cta_download_click, early_access_click) alongside qualified active-escrow search traffic.
styleAndCtaDirectives: APP CTR NORTH STAR: Frame every article around active real estate due diligence—the reader has a seller disclosure or inspection PDF and a ticking contingency clock—so using the DisclosurePro AI app is the immediate next step.

DATA-DRIVEN TITLE RULE: Never use generic 'The Ultimate Guide to Spotting...' titles (0% CTR across 25+ striking-distance pages in GSC). Front-load the exact Search Console query + City/State + statutory form or repair-credit hook (e.g., 'How to Identify Termite Damage in [City, ST] Homes: [Form] & Disclosure Guide' or '[City, ST] Termite Inspections & Disclosures: [Form], Costs & Credits').

REFRESH INTEGRITY AUDIT: Whenever refreshing a legacy Aug/Sep 2026 article, eliminate corrupted currency strings (',000', ',700' caused by legacy shell expansion), replace first-person attorney/broker impersonation with DisclosurePro Real Estate Research Team voice, verify 2024-2026 statutes (e.g., NY $500 PCDS credit repealed / 56 questions, NJ 2024 mandatory PCDS & Flood Risk Act), and replace any legacy inline green <div> CTA with the standardized dual-button <aside class="mid-article-cta">.
Open the first paragraph immediately with concrete dollar stakes ($X,XXX–$XX,XXX) and the exact state statutory form or inspection deadline—never use slow travel-brochure introductions.

Beat banner blindness with an in-copy editorial bridge: Inside the Cost Breakdown / Negotiation or Manual Review section, include 1 natural contextual Markdown link to /download explaining how uploading both the disclosure and inspection PDFs flags hidden contradictions and calculates repair credits in 10 seconds.

Use the standardized dual-button <aside class="mid-article-cta"> component from prompt-template.md featuring BOTH direct 1-click Google Play access (data-gtag-event="play_store_click") and iPhone/Web access (/download, data-gtag-event="blog_cta_click"), with an <h3> tailored to the exact form or defect.

Include an itemized contractor cost breakdown table ($5,000–$55,000+), 3–4 direct question-matching FAQs targeting conversational Search Console queries, and 2–3 contextual internal links (linking city guides UP to state/national hub guides to stop keyword cannibalization).
